svg.aria-label: Case P: full population and registered simultaneous uncertainty
svg.title: Case P: full population and registered simultaneous uncertainty
svg.text: COMSOL and v62: 32 independent seeds each, 287 fixed sources, 121 saved times, full 30 ms
Orange solid: COMSOL; blue dashed: candidate. Terminal difference = COMSOL - candidate; 98.75% simultaneous band.
Confidence band reuses the original evaluator radius across 4 terminal curves x 121 times. No pointwise or pathwise gate is added.
Derived population view; no independent fifth gate.
stuck: difference and original simultaneous band
held: difference and original simultaneous band
escaped: difference and original simultaneous band
any_terminal: difference and original simultaneous band
Horizontal axes: saved time [ms]. Population denominators include all 32 x 287 = 9184 trajectories per participant.
Red dashed limits: +/-5.0%. Original terminal gate: PASS; simultaneous bound 3.5011%.
Lines between saved times are visual guides. Numeric evaluation and original acceptance policy remain authoritative.
